# BathSpace by LUXEhome

> BathSpace by LUXEhome (legal name LUXEhome (Pvt) Ltd) is a complete bathroom renovation company in Sri Lanka. One accountable team handles design, 3D visuals, plumbing, electrical, waterproofing with flood testing, tiling, fixtures, cleaning and documented handover. Website: https://luxehome.lk · Phone/WhatsApp: +94 77 450 3744.

Key facts:
- Service: complete bathroom renovations across Sri Lanka, including for Sri Lankans living abroad. Work outside Colombo is accepted subject to location and scope.
- Typical cost: most complete bathroom renovations are LKR 1.5M–2.5M per bathroom, depending on size, site work, finishes and fixtures.
- Design and quotation package: LKR 30,000 per bathroom (site visit, layout plan, 3D images, walkthrough video, detailed quotation), fully credited against construction if BathSpace is appointed. The first phone or WhatsApp conversation is free.
- Proposal delivered within seven working days of package payment and the site visit.
- Typical programme: about six weeks per bathroom, depending on site condition, scope and procurement.
- Warranty: 24-month workmanship warranty from documented handover, plus a 30-day handover review; products follow manufacturer warranties.
- Named brands: Swiss Bathware, Rocell, Swisstek, Tokyo Super 2K, S-lon, ACL, iPanel, Eco Board.
